title: Blackbird Allseason
notes: Official page read 2026-11-01: all-weather training tire with Mach Tread 3.0 centre and Safetread shoulder compounds; claims exceptional wet-weather grip and a 6,000 km lifespan. Tubeless ready (Gridskin and polyamide, hookless): 700x28 340 g, 30 360 g, 32 380 g, 34 405 g. Tube type (Aramid Pro Tech): 700x26 240 g, 28 258 g. About 127 TPI; black or tan walls; every size marked Made in France.
